purpose: Pinned multilingual title fonts for the WP3 share-card renderer leaf. No system fonts are used; rendering is confined to this directory.

fonts.notes: Base family for Latin titles, digits and card chrome. Variable wdth/wght; Bold/Medium named instances verified via local fontconfig.
Covers Arabic plus Jawi extensions U+0686 U+06A0 U+06A4 U+0762 U+06CF U+06BD (verified in cmap). Joining verified with HarfBuzz.
Locale zh renders with Simplified-Chinese glyph presentation. Traditional-only text falls back to shared Han glyphs; no Traditional-specific variant is vendored.
Conjunct composition verified with HarfBuzz (no dotted-circle placeholders).
Javanese-script (hanacaraka, U+A980-U+A9DF) fallback for locale jv. Latin-script Javanese uses Noto Sans; script is resolved per run by the shaper, never assumed from locale alone.

support_policy.locale_note: Locale selects shaping base direction, alignment, language hint and base family only. It is not a translation claim: card copy is supplied verbatim by the caller.
support_policy.javanese: Locale jv does not imply Latin. Hanacaraka runs shape via Noto Sans Javanese through shaper fallback; Latin runs use Noto Sans.
support_policy.jawi: Jawi titles are Arabic-script titles; the six Jawi extension codepoints are covered by Noto Sans Arabic (see notes).
support_policy.digits: Latin and Arabic-Indic digits are covered; mixed digits inside RTL text follow Unicode bidi (no manual reordering).
support_policy.emoji: Not supported: no emoji font is vendored. Emoji input refuses with a typed unsupported_text non-render (never a .notdef box, never a silent strip); callers should avoid emoji in card text and use the honest cover fallback on refusal.
support_policy.symbols: U+2713 check mark is absent from the Noto Sans base family but covered via fallback; verified state stays text-only by copy choice. Degree sign, middle dot, ellipsis, en dash and joiners are covered. Any visible character without a glyph in the pinned set refuses as unsupported_text, never tofu.
support_policy.forbidden_sources: No Apple, macOS system or third-party mirror fonts. Any file not listed here must fail readiness verification.
